ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED( NSP_Forecast_Status__c ) && ((AND( NOT( $UserRole.Name = 'New Client Sales') , OR( ISPICKVAL(NSP_Forecast_Status__c, 'Pending-Docs Submitted to NCS') , ISPICKVAL(NSP_Forecast_Status__c, 'Sold-Booked')))) || (AND( NOT( $UserRole.Name = 'HCM Sales Consultant' || $Profile.Name = 'Sales Manager' || $UserRole.Name = 'New Client Sales') , ISPICKVAL(NSP_Forecast_Status__c, 'Verbal-Appt Set to Pickup Docs'))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only New Client Sales can set to "Pending-Docs Submitted to NCS" or "Sold-Booked"
